text: I can build an eval set from real traffic and past bugs, sliced by category, and compute the confidence interval its size gives me.
I can name the main LLM-as-judge biases and calibrate a judge against human labels before trusting its scores.
I can set up a CI gate that runs the eval set on every prompt or model change and blocks per-slice regressions.
I can design layered input and output guardrails and explain why least privilege still matters when filters leak.
I can list where PII leaks in an LLM feature (provider, logs, eval sets, other users) and the control for each.
I can choose online quality signals for a dashboard and feed confirmed bad answers back into the eval set.
